review_boundary: P0.2 candidate only; E0/C0 Rust runtime, profile applicability and negative fixtures remain implementation gates. No empirical values or distributions are approved.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 22 CLI scenario configuration
entries.unit_contract: patients/hour or timestamped arrival schedule; select one representation per profile
entries.profile_use: Generate seeded arrivals from exactly one selected representation: a rate process or explicit relative schedule; preserve the schedule origin and source timestamp metadata.
entries.resolution: Generate seeded arrivals from one selected representation (rate process or explicit schedule); preserve exposure, cohort and timestamp origin/zone/precision for calibration, and assert no rate or distribution value.
open_gate: E0 arrival fixture must choose exactly one rate or occurrence-schedule representation and replay identical arrivals from the same run seed.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter
entries.unit_contract: interval bounds use ED-clock seconds; absolute instants retain original precision and explicit offset/zone and are normalized against the dataset UTC origin. Relative MVP schedules start at zero; checked conversion follows ADR-0004, and naive local timestamps or recurrence are rejected until a tested IANA zone adapter defines fold/gap handling.
entries.profile_use: generated calendar modifier for time-varying arrivals, not an observed target.
entries.resolution: Use only as an optional calendar modifier for time-varying arrivals; intervals use ED-clock seconds and instants retain explicit zone/offset and UTC origin. Disable naive local recurrence until IANA fold/gap handling is tested.
open_gate: Reject local recurrence without a declared IANA zone and fold/gap policy; allow relative schedules in the generic fixture.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter, with typed case attributes passed to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: structured categorical/time-varying profile; every numeric leaf declares units, categories, conditioning and denominator.
entries.profile_use: generate a declared surge intensity or occurrence schedule; do not imply a surge distribution or infer dependence from marginal counts.
entries.resolution: Use only when a profile explicitly selects a surge schedule or intensity; interval counts need exposure and baseline, and marginal data do not establish a surge distribution or burst dependence.
open_gate: A surge fixture must declare which demand modifiers change and keep each numeric leaf unit-bearing.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Generate a typed arrival-mode attribute only when the selected pathway branches on mode; preserve category coding and unknown arrivals.
entries.resolution: Generate a typed arrival-mode attribute only where a modeled route branches on mode; declare categories and unknowns, and do not imply universal categories or a duration target.
open_gate: When arrival-mode branching is enabled, reject an undeclared category or missing unknown-category rule.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter, with generated age-band case attributes passed to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless proportions in [0,1] or explicitly declared patient counts; record age-band coding, denominator, conditioning and unknown category. Require mutually exclusive/exhaustive bands only when that representation claims complete coverage.
entries.profile_use: generate arrival case composition; observed age proportions are calibration targets only when cohort and denominator match, and marginal data do not define joint mix.
entries.resolution: Generate age composition with declared bands, denominator and unknown handling; observed proportions target only a matching arrival cohort, and marginals do not establish joint dependence.
open_gate: When age mix is enabled, validate age bands, denominator, conditioning and unknown handling.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter, with generated case-type attributes passed to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless proportions in [0,1] or explicitly declared patient counts; declare category labels, denominator, conditioning and unknown handling.
entries.profile_use: generate a case-type/pathway selector; do not infer its relationship to age or acuity, or a joint distribution, from marginal observations.
entries.resolution: Generate a profile-defined case-type selector with declared categories and eligible-arrival denominator; no taxonomy or age/acuity relationship is implied, and later outcomes cannot be arrival attributes.
open_gate: When case-type mix is enabled, validate declared categories, denominator and unknown handling.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless values in [0,1], denominators/conditioning explicit
entries.profile_use: Generate the initial triage acuity attribute using declared categories and denominator; treat later reassessments as separate events.
entries.resolution: Generate initial acuity using declared triage coding and arrival cohort; reassessment is a separate later state, and observed targets require matching scale/version and timing.
open_gate: The E2 patient fixture must assign scale-versioned initial acuity to every arrival and preserve reassessment as a separate event.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless values in [0,1], denominators/conditioning explicit
entries.profile_use: Exclude from E2 until a named profile specifies joint dimensions, conditioning, denominator and linkage to supplied marginals for patient-level calibration.
entries.resolution: Defer from E2 until a named profile defines joint dimensions, conditioning, denominator and linkage to supplied marginals; patient-level linked attributes are required for calibration.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter, with incoming case attributes passed to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: declared referral category proportions with an arriving-patient denominator, or patient counts with an explicit count unit; include source and unknown category.
entries.profile_use: generate referral arrivals or a referral attribute as explicitly selected by the profile; never treat outgoing referral/disposition as this input.
entries.resolution: Represent incoming referral arrivals or an arrival attribute only when enabled; declare source and arriving-patient denominator, and keep outgoing referral/disposition in pathway outcomes.
open_gate: A referral-enabled fixture must distinguish incoming referral arrivals from outgoing referral outcomes.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter, with incoming transfer case attributes passed to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: declared transfer category proportions with an arriving-patient denominator, or patient counts with explicit count unit; include source boundary and unknown category.
entries.profile_use: represent arrivals entering the ED from an external transfer boundary; outgoing transfer disposition belongs to pathways.transfer.
entries.resolution: Represent incoming transfer arrivals at the external ED boundary with source and denominator; outgoing transfer disposition belongs to pathways.transfer.
open_gate: A transfer-arrival fixture must distinguish incoming transfer from outgoing disposition transfer.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: category labels and conditional proportions with explicit denominator; count-valued input declares patient count
entries.profile_use: Exclude from MVP until linkage key, lookback window, eligible denominator and new-arrival versus prior-history semantics are specified.
entries.resolution: Defer until linkage key, lookback window, eligible denominator and new-arrival versus prior-history semantics are defined; this is distinct from within-episode repeat loops.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure registration as a distinct pathway state when the scenario models it; keep occurrence timing separate from chart-entry time.
entries.resolution: Configure registration as a distinct optional pathway state without imposing clinical content; map occurrence timestamps separately from chart-entry time and arrival-to-registration queueing.
open_gate: A registration-enabled fixture must emit distinct arrival and registration occurrence events.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure triage and routing transitions with explicit category semantics; keep queue wait separate from active triage work.
entries.resolution: Configure triage and routing with explicit category semantics; keep waiting time separate from active triage work, and map observed events to the correct occurrence and triage scale.
open_gate: The triage fixture must separate queue entry, active triage work and triage completion events.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure the assessment sequence and branches; bind observed targets to the correct assessment occurrence.
entries.resolution: Configure the assessment sequence and branches; bind observations to the correct task occurrence and do not treat arrival-to-assessment elapsed time as active work.
open_gate: The assessment fixture must separate active clinician work from queue and local movement.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure diagnostic ordering and dependencies; represent order, procedure, result availability and review as separate modeled events when enabled.
entries.resolution: Configure diagnostic ordering and dependencies; distinguish order, procedure start, result availability and review events, including censoring and missing results.
open_gate: The diagnostic fixture must distinguish order, procedure, result availability and review events.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure treatment pathway choices from modeled case state; keep treatment occurrence and active work distinct from elapsed time to treatment.
entries.resolution: Configure treatment choices from modeled case state; use treatment-specific occurrence anchors and keep queue, assessment and transit out of active treatment work.
open_gate: The treatment fixture must bind the declared task/resource class without inventing a regimen.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps this pathway into Kairos Track 03 Flow transitions
entries.unit_contract: typed pathway states/transitions, with any durations in seconds and probabilities dimensionless with explicit conditioning and denominator.
entries.profile_use: define observation entry, reassessment if applicable, and ED exit/return transitions; model inpatient boarding separately and keep observed events separate from generated pathway rules.
entries.resolution: Enable observation only in selected profiles; separate ED observation from inpatient boarding and map physical bed occupancy/release rather than assignment alone.
open_gate: An observation-enabled fixture must preserve ED observation occupancy separately from inpatient boarding.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps reassessment transitions into Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: typed trigger/transition data; numeric timing leaves use seconds and probability leaves declare conditioning and denominator.
entries.profile_use: specify the trigger, repeated-task occurrence semantics and bounded loop/termination behavior; observed reassessment events are separate targets with occurrence indices and eligible context.
entries.resolution: Enable reassessment only with a defined trigger and bounded repeat semantics; index repeated occurrences and keep observed events separate from generated rules.
open_gate: A reassessment loop fixture must enforce a trigger and bounded termination or occurrence limit.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps consult transitions into Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: typed pathway states/transitions; any durations use seconds and any probabilities declare conditioning and denominator.
entries.profile_use: state the trigger, destination, return or terminal transition and resource claim; do not imply a universal consult route or treat observed consult events as generated rules.
entries.resolution: Enable consult only where applicable; define trigger, destination and return/terminal transition, and distinguish request, acceptance, arrival and completion from active consult work.
open_gate: A consult-enabled fixture must declare trigger, destination, resource claim and return or terminal route.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure discharge as a terminal route; distinguish decision, departure-ready and actual departure events.
entries.resolution: Configure discharge as a terminal route; distinguish decision, departure-ready and actual departure, with boarding/transport and unfinished censored cases kept separate.
open_gate: The discharge fixture must keep decision, departure-ready and physical departure as distinct events.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps admission behavior into Kairos Track 03 Flow and the declared finite bed-offer boundary
entries.unit_contract: typed decision and transition data, with duration leaves in seconds and probabilities carrying explicit conditioning/denominator.
entries.profile_use: keep admission decision, offer/acceptance, boarding occupancy, transport and realized admission/physical ED departure as distinct states or events; an admission decision does not release the ED resource.
entries.resolution: Keep admission decision, offer/acceptance, boarding, transport and physical ED departure distinct; admission decision does not release the occupied ED resource.
open_gate: The admission fixture must keep decision, finite bed offer, acceptance, boarding occupancy and physical ED departure distinct; bed offer alone cannot release the ED resource.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps outgoing transfer disposition into Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: typed destination/eligibility/transition data; numeric durations use seconds and probabilities declare conditioning and denominator.
entries.profile_use: define destination eligibility and the modeled completion boundary for an outgoing transfer; keep incoming transfer arrivals under demand.transfers and do not imply a full fleet or receiving-ward model.
entries.resolution: Model outgoing transfer only when enabled, with destination eligibility and completion boundary; incoming transfers use demand.transfers, and no fleet or receiving-ward model is implied.
open_gate: An outgoing-transfer fixture must declare destination eligibility and terminal boundary separately from incoming transfers.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless values in [0,1], denominators/conditioning explicit
entries.profile_use: Enable abandonment only in selected profiles; distinguish its eligible risk set and departure reason from discharge and censoring.
entries.resolution: Enable abandonment only in selected profiles; define eligible risk set and time at risk, and distinguish it from discharge and right censoring.
open_gate: An abandonment-enabled fixture must define the eligible risk set and terminal reason separately from discharge and right censoring.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies conditional routing tables to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless probabilities in [0,1], with a named decision point, conditioning state, eligible alternatives, denominator, allowed outcomes and normalization rule; identify deterministic versus sampled selection.
entries.profile_use: generate a branch choice conditional on state; calibration against observed choices requires the same eligible alternative set and decision-time state.
entries.resolution: Generate routing choices conditional on named state and eligible alternatives with explicit denominator/normalization; calibrate only against matching decision-time choices.
open_gate: A routing table fixture must declare decision state, eligible alternatives, denominator and normalization rule.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps enabled repeat edges into Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: typed loop edge and trigger, with numeric timing in seconds and any probabilities explicitly conditioned.
entries.profile_use: declare the loop edge, trigger, termination condition or maximum iterations and event accounting; observed loop counts are separate targets requiring occurrence indices and episode boundaries.
entries.resolution: Enable repeat edges only with a trigger and termination or iteration bound; retain occurrence indices, episode boundaries and unfinished/censored loops.
open_gate: A repeat-loop fixture must enforce a trigger and a finite iteration or termination rule.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Configure queue selection priorities only when the profile uses multiple queue classes; bind ordering and tie breaks to the reviewed queue contract.
entries.resolution: Use queue priorities only with multiple queue classes and the reviewed ordering/tie-break contract; realized service order alone does not identify a priority rule.
open_gate: For multiple queue classes, verify priority ordering and deterministic tie breaks against the reviewed queue contract.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies deadline constraints to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: relative limits in decimal seconds; absolute deadlines are explicit-offset instants tied to the dataset UTC origin and retain source precision. Apply ADR-0004 checked conversion to one-nanosecond u128 ticks; reject unsupported precision, negative/overflow values and naive local instants.
entries.profile_use: generated pathway threshold/constraint, distinct from an observed elapsed-time target.
entries.resolution: Use as a generated threshold, with relative seconds or explicit-offset absolute instant tied to UTC origin; define missed-deadline behavior and do not treat it as an elapsed-time distribution.
open_gate: Reject negative, overprecision, overflow and naive civil-time deadlines under ADR-0004.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Configure only reviewed task-preemption behavior; keep staff-task interruption separate from patient or resource eviction.
entries.resolution: Represent reviewed task-preemption policy only; keep task interruption/suspend/resume distinct from patient or resource eviction and require queue-contract evidence.
open_gate: The preemption fixture must keep staff task interruption ancestry separate from patient/resource eviction and verify the reviewed Q lifecycle.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies active-work durations to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with exact fixed-value checks or the declared sampled-duration ceiling rule and precision/rounding metadata.
entries.profile_use: generative active task time; fit only from occurrence-mapped endpoints that isolate active work from setup, queue, transit and interruption/resumption, preserving source precision.
entries.resolution: Generate active task work only; fit from occurrence endpoints isolating setup, queue, transit and interruption/resumption, then apply ADR-0004 checked tick conversion.
open_gate: The intrinsic-work fixture must exclude queue, transit and boarding intervals and apply checked duration conversion.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies setup intervals to Kairos Track 03 Flow and the named task/resource occupancy model
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with checked exactness or declared sampled rounding.
entries.profile_use: identify the owning task/resource, setup start/end and whether capacity is occupied or setup precedes active work; fit only from setup-specific occurrence endpoints distinct from service, queue and transit.
entries.resolution: Enable setup only for a named task/resource and separate start/end; declare capacity occupancy and ordering relative to active work to prevent overlap or double counting.
open_gate: A setup fixture must name the task/resource and declare occupancy and setup start/end events.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies process/device turnaround to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with checked exactness or declared sampled rounding.
entries.profile_use: define the event pair and included external/ED components; keep report availability and clinician review separate and do not silently include ED queue or transit. Fit only to matching occurrence endpoints.
entries.resolution: Enable turnaround only with a defined event pair and included components; separate external/ED delay from queue/transit and keep report availability and clinician review distinct.
open_gate: A turnaround fixture must name included components and distinguish report availability from clinician review.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies report/review delay to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with checked exactness or declared sampled rounding; retain source event precision.
entries.profile_use: generate elapsed delay after the relevant diagnostic process; map observed targets to report-availability and review-occurrence endpoints, keeping order time and recorded/message time separate.
entries.resolution: Generate delay after the diagnostic process; map targets to report availability and review occurrence, keeping order, message and recorded timestamps separate.
open_gate: A report-review fixture must anchor result availability and review occurrence separately from recorded/message times.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies cleaning work to the reusable resource/location availability model consumed by Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with checked exactness or declared sampled rounding.
entries.profile_use: name the resource and map cleaning occurrence start/completion separately from patient departure, bed assignment and resource release; declare concurrency and avoid counting the same interval in task work and availability. Fit only from cleaning-specific endpoints.
entries.resolution: Tie cleaning to a named reusable resource and cleaning start/completion; separate patient departure, bed assignment and resource release, and declare concurrency to avoid double counting.
open_gate: A cleaning fixture must name the resource, cleaning start/completion and bed-ready event separately from patient departure.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies a named handover task to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with checked exactness or declared sampled rounding.
entries.profile_use: specify participants, occurrence start/end and overlap/concurrency treatment; keep ambulance arrival, offload and crew release as separate measures where modeled, and fit only from handover-specific anchors.
entries.resolution: Enable only as a named handover task with participants, occurrence start/end and overlap rule; keep ambulance arrival, offload and crew release as separate measures.
open_gate: A handover fixture must name participants, occurrence endpoints and overlap; distinguish ambulance arrival, offload and crew release.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds externally; fixed values parsed exactly into checked integral nanosecond u128 ticks; sampled finite nonnegative values round upward per ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Use only when the selected pathway has an explicit active disposition task; omit the field from profiles without that task.
entries.resolution: This is optional generated active work after the disposition decision. E0 deferred a generic disposition duration; enable the field only for a route with an identified task owner and decision-ready/work-complete events. Boarding, bed search, transport, and physical departure are separate.
open_gate: E0 route fixture must identify the active disposition task owner and decision-ready/work-complete events; omit the key where that task is absent.
entries.review_note: E0 disposition was defer; coordinator reconciliation records revise solely for optional route-specific active work, not a generic sampled duration.

entries.consumer: C0 trace/metric mapping, and the CareOps ED adapter only if a separately identified residual boundary delay is modeled
entries.unit_contract: elapsed decimal seconds with source precision; fixed values parse exactly to integral nanosecond u128 ticks; sampled finite nonnegative values round upward per ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: For admission-enabled profiles, map the observed provisional-boarding-to-terminal-departure outcome. Configure a residual only after its components are separated.
entries.resolution: Boarding is an observed elapsed boundary from provisional admission/boarding to actual departure or another declared terminal event. Do not model the full observed interval as service or release an ED resource at bed offer; generate only a separately decomposed residual.
open_gate: E0 admission fixture must anchor provisional boarding and actual terminal departure; prove no double counting with service, bed offer, acceptance, transport, or recurrent care.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative decimal seconds; fixed values parse exactly to integral nanosecond u128 ticks and sampled durations round upward per ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Macro may configure aggregate local movement time. Micro derives local time from graph distance and speed and omits this field; external transport is separate.
entries.resolution: Macro may represent aggregate local transit when it is not already part of service work. Micro derives movement from graph distance and speed and excludes this scalar; external transfer/transport has its own boundary input and event anchors.
open_gate: E0 must select Macro aggregate transit or Micro graph-derived movement per profile and keep external transport on its separate boundary input.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Declare the staff role and skill categories used by the E2 task and eligibility rules. Numeric leaves carry their own units; no role counts or identities are inferred.
entries.resolution: Role and skill categories are configuration for E2 task and eligibility rules. Numeric leaves declare units. Observed staff categories remain evidence, not generated configuration or asserted defaults.
open_gate: E2 profile validator must require every referenced staff_role_id and skill category to be declared, and reject numeric leaves without units; confirm observations are mapped separately from generated role configuration.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration validator and ED adapter, which maps role capacity to Kairos Track 03 Flow; synthetic role/zone/location bindings follow the minimum-bindings proposal
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative integer staff persons per declared `staff_role_id` and time basis
entries.profile_use: Supply role-specific counts on an explicitly named employed, rostered, present, or task-eligible basis. Bind roles and eligibility; unknown capacity is not zero.
entries.resolution: Staff counts are generated capacity inputs by role and explicitly named time basis. Employed, rostered, present, and task-eligible counts are distinct; availability schedules modify effective capacity and observed assignments do not imply counts.
open_gate: E2 fixtures must distinguish employed, rostered, present, and task-eligible counts by explicit basis and interval; reject unknown role references and ensure availability schedules, rather than observed assignment totals, determine effective capacity.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration validator and ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow availability
entries.unit_contract: half-open ED-clock intervals in decimal seconds/ticks; generic schedules are relative to origin zero; timestamped instants require declared UTC origin and explicit offset/zone per ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Supply relative-to-zero availability schedules for declared roles/resources. Absolute instants need an origin and explicit offset/zone; local recurrence is disabled.
entries.resolution: Roster availability is configured for declared roles/resources using half-open intervals on the ED clock. Observed rosters and clock events are separate evidence; relative schedules start at zero and local recurrence awaits a tested IANA adapter.
open_gate: Validate role/resource roster bindings, half-open intervals, relative-zero schedules, and timestamp origin/offset handling; reject naive local times and recurring local schedules until the IANA adapter is tested.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow staff availability
entries.unit_contract: half-open ED-clock availability intervals in decimal seconds/ticks; relative schedules use origin zero and checked ADR-0004 conversion
entries.profile_use: Configure breaks only for pathways using break-driven capacity changes; state how in-flight work behaves at each boundary. Keep observed break events separate.
entries.resolution: Breaks change configured staff availability over half-open ED-clock intervals. Define in-flight-work behavior; observed break events are separate and must not be subtracted again from observed busy intervals.
open_gate: Validate break intervals against declared staff capacity and exercise break start/end with in-flight work; confirm observed break events are not subtracted again from observed busy intervals.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration validator and ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow capacity availability
entries.unit_contract: signed integer staff-person capacity delta over half-open ED-clock intervals in decimal seconds/ticks; relative schedules use origin zero; timestamped instants follow ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Configure planned role capacity deltas only for profiles that model absence or overtime. State shift-end and in-flight-work behavior; resulting capacity must stay nonnegative.
entries.resolution: Absence/overtime is a planned signed capacity delta by role over half-open ED-clock intervals. Validate nonnegative resulting capacity and specify shift-end/in-flight-work behavior; observed presence is separate evidence.
open_gate: Test signed role capacity deltas over half-open intervals, nonnegative resulting capacity, and shift-end/in-flight-work behavior; reject unsupported local recurrence and separate observed presence from planned deltas.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as a separately available synthetic staff role/resource
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative integer supervisor persons or explicitly named supervisor-capacity slots per declared zone/location and interval; a supervisor-to-eligible-staff ratio, if proposed later, is a different typed rule with an explicit denominator
entries.profile_use: Supply supervisor capacity only where a pathway declares supervisory eligibility and demand. Bind its role, location/zone, and effective interval.
entries.resolution: Supervision is separately available staff/resource capacity scoped by role, zone/location, and interval. It applies only when a pathway declares eligibility and demand; it does not imply atomic supervisor-plus-worker acquisition.
open_gate: Require declared supervisory role/resource, zone/location, interval, eligibility, and pathway demand; verify unavailable supervisor capacity blocks only tasks that require it and does not imply atomic worker-plus-supervisor acquisition.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow only as a named resource's simultaneous-slot capacity
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative integer concurrent slots per `resource_id`
entries.profile_use: Use only for simultaneous slots of a named resource pool. This does not configure one staff agent to perform concurrent tasks.
entries.resolution: This field limits simultaneous slots for a named resource only. Per-agent task concurrency remains outside the contract unless a separate reviewed behavior defines it; observed overlaps are telemetry.
open_gate: Bind slot capacity to a named resource_id and test concurrent allocation limits; confirm this field cannot be used as per-agent task concurrency and that observed overlaps do not set capacity.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow resource capacity, bound by stable `resource_id`, `zone_id`, and `location_id` as specified by the minimum-bindings proposal
entries.unit_contract: integer physical bed count per explicitly identified pool; open, staffed, usable, capability-compatible capacity and occupancy are separate typed states/intervals
entries.profile_use: Declare physical bed inventory by identified pool and bind each pool to stable resource, zone, and location IDs. State effective availability separately from inventory.
entries.resolution: Beds are physical inventory by identified pool; staffed, usable, compatible, open capacity and occupancy are separate states. An inpatient offer is a boundary event, not an ED bed or automatic ED release.
open_gate: Validate each bed pool’s resource_id, zone_id, location_id, physical count, effective availability, compatibility, and occupancy against the same pool; verify an inpatient offer does not release an ED resource.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow resource capacity, using distinct stable pool/location/zone IDs and explicit room function/pathway eligibility
entries.unit_contract: integer physical rooms per identified pool; treatment-space capacity and time-effective availability are separately declared
entries.profile_use: Declare physical room pools with function and pathway eligibility. Model room availability separately; do not infer rooms from beds or beds from rooms.
entries.resolution: Rooms are physical pools with explicit function/pathway eligibility. Treatment capacity and time-varying availability are separate from inventory; room and bed lifecycles are independent.
open_gate: Validate room pool IDs, function, pathway eligibility, location/zone bindings, and effective availability independently of bed pools; test concurrent room use and reject inferred room/bed equivalence.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow resource pools, each with stable resource/item identity and zone/location binding
entries.unit_contract: integer physical item count by declared equipment class/capability; working, available, pathway-compatible capacity and allocation intervals are distinct fields
entries.profile_use: Declare equipment inventory by class/capability and stable identity/location. Allocate only known, available compatible capacity; trips remain separate.
entries.resolution: Equipment inventory is by declared class/capability and stable item/pool binding. Working, available, compatible capacity and allocation are distinct; do not imply atomic bundles.
open_gate: Validate equipment item/pool identity, class/capability, zone/location binding, working/available/compatible capacity, and allocation; confirm trip events cannot create or alter inventory and unsupported bundles are rejected.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow availability for an explicitly named resource, location, or pathway
entries.unit_contract: half-open ED-clock intervals in decimal seconds/ticks for effective capacity state; relative schedules use origin zero and checked ADR-0004 conversion
entries.profile_use: Configure open intervals and capacity state for a named resource, location, or pathway. Keep observed openings/closures separate; local recurrence is disabled.
entries.resolution: Opening calendars configure effective intervals and capacity for named targets, not observed utilization. Observed changes remain events; relative schedules start at zero and local recurrence is disabled pending tested zone behavior.
open_gate: Validate each open-calendar target and capacity state over half-open intervals; test relative-zero/explicit-offset conversion and reject naive local or recurring schedules pending the tested IANA adapter.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as a capacity/status change on a declared `resource_id` or pool
entries.unit_contract: outage state/capacity delta over half-open ED-clock intervals in decimal seconds/ticks; relative schedules use origin zero and checked ADR-0004 conversion
entries.profile_use: Configure outages as capacity/status changes for named resources or pools. Define in-flight allocation behavior and keep observed failure times separate.
entries.resolution: Outages change configured capacity/status for a named resource or pool. Define active-allocation behavior, reject negative capacity, and do not encode the same outage again as sampled service delay.
open_gate: Validate outage target and capacity delta/state, reject negative capacity, and test the declared handling of active allocations; ensure the same outage is not also applied as a sampled service delay.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow resource lifecycle for a named owner/task and `resource_id`
entries.unit_contract: reservation effective interval in decimal seconds/ticks; relative schedules use origin zero and checked ADR-0004 conversion; expiry/release rule is explicit
entries.profile_use: Use explicit owner/task and resource IDs with reservation, expiry, and release semantics. Keep reservation distinct from assignment and physical occupancy.
entries.resolution: A reservation is a claim by a named owner/task on a resource for an effective interval, with explicit expiry/release. It is distinct from assignment, occupancy, and cleaning/ready lifecycle.
open_gate: Require reservation owner/task and resource_id plus explicit expiry/release behavior; test reservation versus assignment/occupancy/cleaning states and retain separate occurrence/recorded lineage for observed events.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as named cleaner staff/equipment resources or simultaneous cleaning slots
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative integer cleaning capacity per resource/binding; any separate cleaning duration is decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Declare cleaning staff/equipment or cleaning slots as capacity. Model clean duration separately and keep the bed/room unavailable until ready completion.
entries.resolution: Cleaning capacity is named cleaner staff/equipment or simultaneous slots. Cleaning duration is a separate seconds input; hold the resource unavailable until the declared ready event.
open_gate: A cleaning-enabled E2 fixture must bind cleaner capacity and cleaning duration separately, and retain resource unavailability until ready completion.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED schema and ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow agent/task context
entries.unit_contract: versioned categorical coding; every numeric leaf declares its own unit and entity scope
entries.profile_use: Include only staff attributes used by declared eligibility or task behavior. Mark scope and provenance; numeric attributes require entity scope and units.
entries.resolution: Staff attributes are generated only when required by declared eligibility or task behavior, with fixed/time-varying scope and provenance. Calibration requires staff-level evidence and identifiability; no unsupported demographic or clinical detail is implied.
open_gate: When agent attributes affect eligibility, reject missing scope, unit or provenance and prevent unused attributes becoming implicit policy.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow dispatch inputs, constrained by declared role, task, zone, location, availability, and skill eligibility
entries.unit_contract: typed categorical assignment policy/state; numeric leaves declare units
entries.profile_use: Use an explicit supported dispatch rule over declared role, task, location, availability, and skill eligibility. Record observed assignments as separate events.
entries.resolution: Assignment policy generates staff-to-task choices subject to declared role, task, zone/location, availability, and skill eligibility. Observed assignments are separate events; aggregate duration/throughput cannot identify the policy.
open_gate: The E2 dispatch fixture must select only currently available eligible role/task/location combinations and log assignments separately from configuration.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow dispatch eligibility
entries.unit_contract: versioned relation among stable `staff_role_id`, `task_class_id`, `zone_id`, and optional `location_id` (no physical unit); all references must resolve exactly, and a location must belong to its declared zone
entries.profile_use: Provide exact role/task/zone and optional location eligibility bindings wherever work is spatially assigned, including Macro placement. Every reference must resolve.
entries.resolution: Eligibility is a configured relation among declared role, task class, zone, and optional location. Validate exact references and zone membership; observed-choice evidence needs a time-specific full choice set.
open_gate: The Macro E2 fixture must reject an unknown role, task, zone or location reference and an undeclared eligibility edge.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow for selecting among supported eligible task actions
entries.unit_contract: versioned deterministic/structured policy with category coding; any numeric leaf declares its unit
entries.profile_use: Select a supported task-choice policy for declared task classes and eligibility/priority inputs. Treat it as an assumption without full decision-set evidence.
entries.resolution: Task choice selects among supported eligible actions. Observed task starts alone omit the available alternatives; empirical fitting requires decision times, actor/task states, and the complete eligible-action set.
open_gate: A task-choice fixture must record its eligible action set and declared priority rule; no unobserved decision heuristic becomes an empirical default.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as a pathway-enabled reassessment trigger/cadence rule
entries.unit_contract: typed trigger/threshold; any interval is decimal seconds converted to checked nanosecond ticks under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Configure a reassessment trigger/cadence only for pathways that enable it. Map observed occurrence, observation window, recording time, and censoring separately.
entries.resolution: Reassessment is a pathway-enabled trigger or cadence rule, not a scalar observed target. Preserve occurrence, recording time, at-risk window, and censoring in observations.
open_gate: A reassessment-enabled fixture must distinguish configured cadence from occurrence and recording time, including censoring at the observation boundary.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter supplies priority attributes and stable tie-break inputs to Kairos Track 03 Flow's reviewed queue ordering
entries.unit_contract: versioned ordinal policy with no physical unit
entries.profile_use: Use the declared ordinal urgency order and stable FIFO tie-break. Keep priority assignment explicit and do not add unsupported thresholds.
entries.resolution: Urgency/FIFO is a deterministic ordinal ordering policy with a stable tie-break. ED-side priority assignment is explicit; queue order and waits are outcomes, not standalone calibration targets.
open_gate: A two-task fixture must prove ordinal urgency ordering and deterministic FIFO tie breaks under the Q contract.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow for explicitly modeled handover interaction/task events
entries.unit_contract: categorical interaction/policy; any active-work duration is decimal seconds with source precision and explicit anchors, converted under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Enable only for pathways with explicit handover interactions. Define ownership and any active-work anchors; do not assume simultaneous attention or infer work from gaps.
entries.resolution: Handover is an explicit interaction/task event with declared ownership and any active-work anchors. Preserve occurrence versus recording/message time; an elapsed gap is not handover work.
open_gate: A handover-enabled fixture must name ownership transfer and active-work occurrence anchors; no elapsed gap is auto-counted as handover work.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter selects a supported Suspend/Abort/Restart policy for Kairos Track 03 Flow task lifecycle
entries.unit_contract: versioned categorical lifecycle policy; any timed leaf is decimal seconds with source precision and ADR-0004 conversion
entries.profile_use: Select only a task lifecycle policy supported by the reviewed Q contract. Preserve interrupted task identity, ancestry, cause, and occurrence/recorded timestamps.
entries.resolution: Interruption/resumption selects a lifecycle policy supported by the Q contract. Retain task identity/ancestry, cause, prompt, next task, resumption, and timestamp lineage; an incoming prompt or elapsed gap alone is not a switch/work interval.
open_gate: A preemption fixture must preserve task ancestry, cause and elapsed/remaining work through suspend, abort or restart under the Q lifecycle.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as explicit active context-switch work, if enabled by the pathway
entries.unit_contract: nonnegative decimal seconds with source precision; fixed input parses exactly and sampled duration rounds upward to checked nanosecond ticks under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Configure context-switch active work only where enabled, with explicit start/end semantics. Keep queueing, suspension, handover, and resumption separate.
entries.resolution: Switching overhead is optional active context-switch work with generated start/end semantics. Exclude queueing, suspension, handover, and resumption unless separately modeled; no value or distribution is asserted.
open_gate: A switching-overhead fixture must isolate active switch work from queueing, suspension, handover and resumption intervals.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Use a versioned synthetic graph only when a profile enables Micro movement. Macro uses named categorical locations without route geometry.
entries.resolution: Graph topology is a generated, versioned set of candidate walkable connections used only by Micro movement. Keep named identities separate from observed paths; geometry import and visualization are outside this input.
open_gate: A Micro fixture must validate the versioned graph and reachable endpoints; the Macro fixture must run with no route graph.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: metres per versioned graph edge; never drawing scale or coordinate transform
entries.profile_use: Use as metres for each versioned graph edge only in Micro movement profiles. Keep drawing scale, coordinate transforms, and imported geometry outside this field.
entries.resolution: The stable inventory ID now denotes versioned graph-edge length in metres under spatial.graph_edge_length_m. Drawing scale, coordinate transforms and imported geometry require separate contracts; no distance is inferred from a CAD drawing.
open_gate: A Micro movement fixture must apply checked distance/speed-to-time conversion for a versioned graph edge and reject unknown or invalid edge length.
entries.review_note: Provisional CSV says accept; independent review changed the disposition to revise. The resolved config key now explicitly means graph-edge length in metres.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow for stable named location/zone references and resource/staff bindings
entries.unit_contract: stable IDs and coded location type/zone have no physical unit; optional coordinates declare frame, scale, metres, and provenance
entries.profile_use: Require stable nonempty zone/location IDs and consistent resource/staff bindings in every E2 profile, including Macro. Coordinates and geometry are optional Micro inputs.
entries.resolution: Named locations/zones and resource/staff bindings are required categorical configuration even in Macro. Micro may add coordinates/geometry with declared frame, scale, units, and provenance; display names are not identifiers.
open_gate: E2 profile/schema must require nonempty stable zone_id and location_id values and validate resource/staff bindings in Macro; add no geometry requirement.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED validator and ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow only when a profile explicitly enables Micro movement
entries.unit_contract: versioned graph/edge IDs and access categories; edge distance in metres, speed in metres/second, and travel duration in decimal seconds/ticks under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Provide graph edges and access rules only when Micro movement is enabled. Macro uses named location bindings and adds no local travel cost.
entries.resolution: Connectivity is generated graph/access configuration for Micro only. Keep observed or sensor-smoothed paths separate, and do not add fabricated Macro transit cost or unreviewed congestion.
open_gate: A Micro route fixture must reject unreachable endpoints and invalid access edges against the declared graph revision.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: m/s
entries.profile_use: Configure metres-per-second movement speed only for Micro movement. Macro does not consume walking speed.
entries.resolution: Walking speed is a generated Micro movement input in metres/second, separate from edge distance. Observed movement speeds remain evidence and require suitable provenance before calibration.
open_gate: A Micro movement fixture must reject missing, zero or invalid speed and avoid applying speed to Macro placement.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow as optional Micro movement/retrieval events or a generating rule, not as resource capacity. Unit class: structured event/rule; declare trip purpose, equipment/supply class, origin and destination IDs, movement mode, event count over a defined exposure window, and any time fields in seconds/ticks under ADR-0004. Stage/use: enable only in an explicit Micro profile; equipment inventory and availability remain in `resources.equipment`, and Macro must not add local travel. Observed trip events retain occurrence/recorded precision and are separate from generated trips; do not infer inventory from frequency.
entries.unit_contract: structured event/rule; timing fields use decimal seconds and checked ADR-0004 tick conversion; event counts declare an exposure window
entries.profile_use: Enable trip events or a trip-generating rule only in Micro. Define purpose, class, endpoints, mode, and exposure; keep inventory in resources.equipment.
entries.resolution: Trips are optional Micro movement/retrieval events or a generating rule, not resource capacity. Declare purpose, class, endpoints, mode, exposure, and timing; observed trips are separate from generated trips and do not identify inventory.
open_gate: A supply-trip fixture must name purpose, equipment class, origin, destination and timing; equipment inventory remains a separate resource.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow for optional Micro path selection over a versioned graph
entries.unit_contract: categorical/deterministic policy unless a reviewed probability model is supplied with declared normalization and conditioning
entries.profile_use: Apply route choice only in Micro over a versioned graph and the reachable eligible alternatives at decision time. A declared deterministic route suffices when choice is disabled.
entries.resolution: Route choice is conditional on a versioned graph, movement mode, origin/destination, and reachable eligible alternatives. Keep observed paths separate; aggregate travel time does not identify route preference.
open_gate: A route-choice fixture must enumerate reachable alternatives; a deterministic route must work without an inferred choice distribution.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter to Kairos Track 03 Flow only for Micro movement lifecycle
entries.unit_contract: typed trigger/cause and progress rule; distance in metres, speed in metres/second, and pause/work durations in decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004
entries.profile_use: Enable only as an optional Micro movement rule with typed cause, progress, pause, and resumption. Macro adds no movement time.
entries.resolution: Travel interruptions are optional Micro lifecycle rules with typed cause, route progress, pause, and resumption. Route-derived time excludes separately generated pause time; observed interruption records retain event lineage and censoring.
open_gate: Micro lifecycle fixture must type cause, progress, pause, and resumption and demonstrate route time excludes separately generated pause time.

entries.consumer: Future spatial fidelity owner; consumer not applicable until that scope is approved
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Excluded from all current profiles; re-enter only after the separately reviewed spatial-fidelity extension trigger.
entries.resolution: Keep congestion outside current profiles; re-enter only when a reviewed post-v1 extension defines its mechanism, exposure, event/time mapping, units, identifiability and fixtures.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: s canonical input; convert from explicit source/config unit to ED clock ticks
entries.profile_use: Optional only when the selected E2 profile enables queue abandonment.
entries.resolution: Use an optional abandonment threshold in seconds or typed hazard only when abandonment is enabled; observed abandonment events and right-censored at-risk times remain separate targets.
open_gate: Validate optional threshold/hazard shape and time units; test that observed abandonment/censoring fields are not consumed as generated patience.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless values in [0,1], denominators/conditioning explicit
entries.profile_use: Conditional generative abandonment policy only when the selected profile enables that pathway.
entries.resolution: Use generative abandonment only for the enabled leaving-without-being-seen pathway, with declared category coding, conditioning and eligible-patient denominator.
open_gate: Validate supported categories, conditioning and eligible-patient denominator for the enabled pathway; preserve observed events/censoring separately.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: patient attribute/rule; age, count, probability or time leaves carry explicit units
entries.profile_use: Excluded from MVP unless a named profile enables movement constraints and defines categories and affected rules.
entries.resolution: Defer assistance attributes until a named profile defines movement constraints, categories, affected rules and route/location applicability.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless values in [0,1], denominators/conditioning explicit
entries.profile_use: Excluded from MVP unless a named profile enables route choice and defines alternatives and outcomes.
entries.resolution: Defer route compliance until a named profile defines eligible alternatives, intended route, compliance state and observable outcome.

entries.consumer: Future patient-behavior owner; consumer not applicable until relevance is established
entries.unit_contract: patient attribute/rule; age, count, probability or time leaves carry explicit units
entries.profile_use: Excluded from current MVP profiles; requires a separately scoped companion entity extension.
entries.resolution: Defer companion entities until a scoped profile defines interactions, resource effects and supporting evidence or explicit assumptions.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter at the admission boundary
entries.unit_contract: Finite timestamped external competing-demand schedule with declared count, time unit and provenance; distinct from ED generated admission requests, ED arrivals, bed offers and observed boarding targets.
entries.profile_use: Optional external competing admission demand in an MVP admission/boarding fixture; separate from ED generated admission requests, ED arrivals, bed offers and boarding targets.
entries.resolution: Model finite external competing admission demand at the admission boundary, separate from ED-generated requests, ED arrivals, bed offers and observed boarding targets.
open_gate: Validate finite timestamped schedule/count/provenance and verify external demand competes only for inpatient offers without creating ED arrivals or duplicate admission requests.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter at the admission/boarding boundary
entries.unit_contract: Finite ED eligible offer records with destination compatibility, availability start/expiry, withdrawal state/time and explicit competing-demand assumptions; every numeric leaf declares units.
entries.profile_use: Finite exogenous ED eligible inpatient offers only in an MVP admission/boarding fixture; does not itself end ED occupancy.
entries.resolution: Consume finite exogenous ED-eligible bed offers with destination, availability/expiry, withdrawal and competing-demand fields; an accepted offer does not end ED occupancy.
open_gate: Validate offer destination, availability/expiry and withdrawal; verify offer acceptance does not release ED occupancy before actual departure.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow boundary
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Boundary input only for an enabled transfer pathway.
entries.resolution: Treat transfer transport as an exogenous boundary record only for enabled transfer pathways; keep numeric leaves unit-bearing.
open_gate: Validate typed transfer/transport boundary records and unit-bearing numeric leaves for the enabled transfer fixture.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow boundary
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Boundary input only for explicitly modeled diagnostic dependencies.
entries.resolution: Treat diagnostic dependencies as exogenous boundary inputs only when that dependency is explicitly modeled; keep numeric leaves unit-bearing.
open_gate: Validate typed diagnostic-dependency records and unit-bearing numeric leaves for the explicitly modeled dependency fixture.

entries.consumer: Future hospital-domain owner; consumer not applicable to generic ED MVP
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Excluded from MVP; requires a separately reviewed whole hospital mechanism extension.
entries.resolution: Defer whole-hospital mechanisms until a reviewed extension defines additional state, scope, evidence and interface.

entries.consumer: Future CareOps ED ABM profile; no current Kairos consumer
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Excluded from current profiles pending a scoped fatigue mechanism and evidence.
entries.resolution: Defer fatigue until a scoped extension defines its staff-capacity mechanism, evidence window and validation fixture.

entries.consumer: Future CareOps ED ABM profile; no current Kairos consumer
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Excluded from current profiles pending a scoped learning mechanism and evidence.
entries.resolution: Defer learning until a scoped extension defines skill/behavior state, exposure history, timescale, evidence and validation.

entries.consumer: Future CareOps ED model profile; Kairos 03 Flow only after scoped acceptance
entries.unit_contract: deferred extension schema; numeric leaves carry explicit units if enabled
entries.profile_use: Excluded from current profiles; occupancy metrics alone do not enable feedback.
entries.resolution: Defer crowding feedback until a reviewed extension defines causal exposure/outcome mapping, units, identifiability and fixtures; occupancy alone is insufficient.

entries.consumer: Future CareOps ED model profile; no current Kairos consumer
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Excluded from the generic MVP pending reviewed clinical scope and validation.
entries.resolution: Defer detailed physiology until reviewed clinical scope defines state transitions, units, evidence and validation.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 22 CLI
entries.unit_contract: initial occupancy/state record; each numeric leaf declares its own unit and coding
entries.profile_use: Initial state supplied explicitly for the selected MVP scenario; no hidden default.
entries.resolution: Require explicit initial occupancy and ongoing state records so MVP runs have no hidden initialization defaults; declare units and coding on numeric leaves.
open_gate: Validate initial occupancy and ongoing-work state against configured locations/resources and declared numeric-leaf units; reject hidden defaults.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 22 CLI
entries.unit_contract: s canonical input; convert from explicit source/config unit to ED clock ticks
entries.profile_use: Optional elapsed ages for explicitly initialized ongoing work.
entries.resolution: Represent ongoing-work age as elapsed time at initialization, in seconds with checked ADR-0004 conversion; it is not a civil timestamp.
open_gate: Validate elapsed age source units and checked ADR-0004 conversion at initialization.

entries.consumer: Proposed Kairos 22 CLI; Kairos 21 calibration
entries.unit_contract: s canonical input; convert from explicit source/config unit to ED clock ticks
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 experiment control; omitted from E2.
entries.resolution: Reserve warm-up as a hardened-v1 duration relative to run origin; it is outside the functional MVP.

entries.consumer: Proposed Kairos 22 CLI
entries.unit_contract: s canonical input; convert from explicit source/config unit to ED clock ticks
entries.profile_use: Required bounded elapsed run horizon for E2.
entries.resolution: Require a bounded elapsed run horizon from run origin, in seconds with checked ADR-0004 conversion; it is not a civil timestamp.
open_gate: Validate required horizon source units, nonnegative bound and checked ADR-0004 conversion from run origin.

entries.consumer: Proposed Kairos 22 CLI; Kairos 21 calibration
entries.unit_contract: non-negative integer count; resource identity and availability are separate
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 replication control; omitted from E2.
entries.resolution: Reserve replication count for hardened-v1 experiments; it is an experiment control, separate from resource identity and availability.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration validator and Kairos 22 run orchestrator
entries.unit_contract: One unsigned 64-bit run seed (u64, 0..2^64-1) matching pinned Kairos CLI ScenarioManifest.base_seed; no physical unit. Named purpose streams are a separate Kairos Track 01 contract.
entries.profile_use: One explicit run seed is required for an MVP run; named stream allocation is deferred to Kairos Track 01.
entries.resolution: Require one explicit u64 run seed for E2 and pass it to the pinned Kairos scenario/seed manifest contract; identical input plus seed must replay. Named stream derivation remains Kairos Track 01 work and is not an E2 config requirement.
open_gate: E0 must reject negative, noninteger or >u64 run seeds, pass the valid seed to the Kairos manifest and verify deterministic replay for identical inputs.
entries.review_note: Coordinator clarifies the MVP key as a single run seed; the stable parameter ID remains seedstreams and named stream derivation stays with Kairos Track 01. Pinned Kairos CLI scenario.rs declares ScenarioManifest.base_seed and SeedManifest.base_seed as u64.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED adapter
entries.unit_contract: Each time-valued field declares its source unit; normalize fixed durations exactly to decimal seconds, then convert once with checked ADR-0004 one-nanosecond-per-u128-tick profile. Sampled finite nonnegative durations round upward.
entries.profile_use: No global experiment.timeunits key; every time-valued field declares its source unit and uses the reviewed seconds-to-ticks adapter contract.
entries.resolution: Remove the global experiment.timeunits switch; declare units per time field, normalize fixed durations to decimal seconds and use checked ADR-0004 tick conversion, rounding sampled finite nonnegative durations upward.
open_gate: Validate per-field source-unit declarations, exact fixed-duration normalization, checked ADR-0004 conversion and upward rounding for sampled finite nonnegative durations.
entries.review_note: Coordinator replaces the non-key prose placeholder with a stable schema-field metadata path; there is no global runtime time-unit switch.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED schema and selected profile
entries.unit_contract: Documented enumerated modes supported by the selected profile; structured numeric leaves declare units.
entries.profile_use: Only documented profile-supported scenario modes; fixed within calibration comparisons or declared as strata, never fitted.
entries.resolution: Allow only documented modes supported by the selected profile; record resolved modes and keep them fixed or stratified during calibration comparisons.
open_gate: Validate mode names against the selected profile and record the resolved mode in run provenance.

entries.consumer: Kairos 21 calibration/validation and Kairos 22 experiment orchestration
entries.unit_contract: Explicit elapsed duration with named run/episode/study origin, or absolute source-time interval retaining original timestamps, offset/timezone, DST resolution and source precision; checked ADR-0004 conversion.
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 observation/calibration metadata; never a generated patient duration.
entries.resolution: Reserve observation windows for hardened-v1; distinguish elapsed durations with named origins from absolute source intervals with timestamp, timezone/DST and precision metadata.

entries.consumer: Proposed Kairos 21 calibration
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 calibration candidate bounds; distinct from physical limits, observations, scenario ranges and uncertainty.
entries.resolution: Reserve calibration bounds for hardened-v1 and keep candidate bounds separate from physical limits, observed ranges, scenario ranges and uncertainty.

entries.consumer: Hardened v1 Kairos 04 trace mapping and Kairos 21 calibration
entries.unit_contract: Observed target in source units; retain raw timestamps, endpoints, timezone/offset, precision, provenance and occurrence/recording lineage; derive seconds only through versioned mapping with explicit cohort/denominator.
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 observed target only; separate from generated/simulated durations.
entries.resolution: Treat elapsed intervals as hardened-v1 observed targets; preserve source timestamps and derive elapsed seconds only through a versioned endpoint/cohort/denominator mapping.

entries.consumer: Hardened v1 Kairos 04 trace mapping and Kairos 21 calibration
entries.unit_contract: Observed validation target in canonical seconds with explicit queue-entry and grant/start endpoints, clock, cohort, denominator, missingness and censoring.
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 observed queue-delay target only; separate from generated/simulated work.
entries.resolution: Treat queue delay as a hardened-v1 observed target; define queue-entry and grant/start endpoints and keep observed and simulated delays separate.

entries.consumer: Proposed Kairos 04 Arrow trace mapping; Kairos 21 calibration
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 event mapping metadata, separate from pathway generation.
entries.resolution: Reserve event definitions for hardened-v1 trace mapping; keep observation semantics separate from pathway-generation rules.

entries.consumer: Proposed Kairos 04 Arrow trace mapping; Kairos 21 calibration
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 observed cohort inclusion/exclusion metadata.
entries.resolution: Reserve inclusion criteria for hardened-v1 observed cohort definition; they do not define generative rules.

entries.consumer: Proposed Kairos 21 calibration; Kairos 22 CLI reporting
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 metric denominator semantics.
entries.resolution: Reserve metric denominator semantics for hardened-v1 measurement mapping.

entries.consumer: Hardened v1 Kairos 04 trace mapping and Kairos 21 calibration
entries.unit_contract: Observation metadata: preserve occurrence and source-recorded/message-created timestamps separately with source precision, offset/timezone where absolute, provenance, and recording delay in declared source units as evidence-backed or unknown.
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 timestamp and recording metadata; never process duration.
entries.resolution: Reserve timestamp precision and recording delay as hardened-v1 metadata; keep occurrence and recorded timestamps distinct and never infer delay from resolution.

entries.consumer: Proposed Kairos 04 Arrow trace mapping; Kairos 21 calibration
entries.unit_contract: explicit observed-data missingness metadata and mapping policy; numeric leaves declare units if present
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 observed-data missingness metadata.
entries.resolution: Reserve missingness policy as hardened-v1 observed-data metadata, explicit in cohort and metric accounting.

entries.consumer: Proposed Kairos 04 Arrow trace mapping; Kairos 21 calibration
entries.unit_contract: explicit observed-trace censoring semantics and mapping; numeric leaves declare units if present
entries.profile_use: Hardened v1 observed-trace censoring semantics, distinct from terminal simulated outcomes.
entries.resolution: Reserve censoring semantics for hardened-v1 observed traces; keep them distinct from missingness and terminal simulated outcomes.
